page.returned: The approver returned this request for changes. Change it, then press Send for approval again on the last step
page.unknownType: This request type does not exist or was switched off. Choose another type on the Buy or hire page
page.forbidden: This account cannot create requests. Contact your organization's administrator
page.sent: This request was sent, so it can no longer be changed. Open it to see where it stands
page.cancelled: This request was cancelled, so it can no longer be changed. Open it to see its history, or start a new request from Buy or hire
page.notYours: You can change only your own requests. Open the request to see it if you may
page.lostEditTitle: You can no longer change this request
page.lostEdit: You are this request's requester, but this account can no longer change requests. Ask your organization's administrator to check the account's status and roles
page.viewOnly: Only the requester who created this request can change it. Your account may open it, but not change it
page.noAccess: Only the requester who created this request can change it, and your account may not open it. If your work needs it, contact the requester or your organization's administrator

save.idleNew: The draft saves itself once you start filling it in
save.idleSaved: This draft is saved; your changes save themselves
save.dirty: Unsaved changes: they are saved 10 seconds after you stop typing or when you leave this page
save.error: The draft could not be saved. Check your internet connection, then press Save the draft now
save.conflict: This draft was changed on another device or tab after you opened it, so your latest changes on this page are not saved. Load the latest version and continue from it
save.closed: This request was sent or cancelled elsewhere, so it can no longer be changed on this page

closedBy.SENT: This request was sent from elsewhere, so it can no longer be changed on this page, and what you changed here since the draft was last saved is not saved. If what was sent needs to change, cancel the request on its page and start a new one
closedBy.CANCELLED: This request was cancelled from elsewhere, so it can no longer be changed on this page, and what you changed here since the draft was last saved is not saved. If you still need it, start a new request from the Buy or hire page
closedBy.NOT_FOUND: This request is not found for the account signed in now, so it can no longer be changed on this page, and what you changed here since the draft was last saved is not saved. If you just signed in with another account, sign in with yours and reload this page; if not, contact your organization's administrator
closedBy.FORBIDDEN: The account signed in now cannot change this request, so it can no longer be changed on this page, and what you changed here since the draft was last saved is not saved. If you just signed in with another account, sign in with yours and reload this page; if not, ask your organization's administrator to check the account's roles
closedBy.ELSEWHERE: This request was sent or cancelled elsewhere, so it can no longer be changed on this page, and what you changed here since the draft was last saved is not saved

save.openRequest: Open the request to see where it stands
save.failed: The draft could not be saved: {reason}

details.title: Request title
details.titleHint: A short name the approver sees, for example Building materials for the Bang Na project

fields.moneyHint: An amount in baht, for example 1500 or 1,500.50
fields.unsupported: This field cannot be filled in on this form yet. Contact your organization's administrator

budget.title: Budget
budget.lineHint: Only your department's lines or lines you were granted. The department that owns the budget approves
budget.unknown: What is left cannot be shown right now. Try again later
budget.notUsable: This budget line can no longer be used (another department's without a grant, or closed). Choose another line in Request details
budget.notUsableShort: This line cannot be used; choose another
budget.noLines: You have no budget line you can use this fiscal year. Ask your organization's budget administrators for a line or a grant
budget.chooseMissing: Choose the budget line this request uses
budget.noLine: No budget line chosen yet. Choose one in Request details
budget.short: Not enough budget: {shortfall} baht short. Lower the amount or choose another budget line

lines.pricesIncludeVat: The prices I enter include VAT
lines.serviceEndDateHint: The last day this service or licence runs
lines.amountPending: Enter the quantity and price to see the amount
lines.quantityInvalid: Enter a quantity above 0, for example 1 or 2.5
lines.priceInvalid: Enter the price as a number with at most 2 decimals, for example 1500 or 1,500.50
lines.serviceEndDateChosen: The last day this service or licence runs: {date}
lines.removeReserved: This item holds {amount} baht of the budget. Once the draft is saved, that amount goes back to the budget line at once; sending the request again reserves for the items that are left

totals.title: Totals
totals.noRate: There is no VAT rate for today, so totals cannot be worked out. Contact the platform administrator
totals.pending: {count, plural, one {# item is} other {# items are}} not complete yet: not in these totals and not saved

documents.noneRequired: At this amount and with these answers no document is needed. You may still add quotations or other files

rules.always: it is a request of this type
rules.files: {kind}: at least {min} {min, plural, one {file} other {files}} ({have} attached)

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.intro: Enter each quotation as data: supplier, amount and file. Their prices before VAT are compared as you type; choose the one you will use
quotations.empty: No quotations yet. Press Add a quotation if you have one, or when a rule above asks for it
quotations.netPending: Enter the supplier and the amount to compare prices
quotations.reasonHint: The chosen quotation is not the lowest before VAT. Say why, for example delivery two weeks sooner
quotations.reasonMissing: Say why you did not choose the lowest quotation
quotations.amountMissing: Enter the amount on the quotation
quotations.amountInvalid: Enter the amount as a number with at most 2 decimals
quotations.removeWithFile: Its file {name} is taken off the request too

attachments.title: Other files
attachments.intro: Choose what the file is before attaching it, for example a data processing agreement (DPA) or a photo
attachments.removeQuestion: Take the file {name} off the request?
attachments.notAttachedDraft: The file {name} is not in the request yet, because the draft could not be saved. See why on the draft's line at the top of the page, fix it, then attach this file again

files.rule: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC pictures, or Excel and Word files (xlsx, docx), up to 20 MB

route.title: Expected approval route
route.unknown: The approval route cannot be worked out right now. Try again later
route.noRoute: This request goes straight to procurement; no DOA approver is needed
route.needsAmount: Enter items and prices first, then the approval route can be shown
route.explain: {doa} version {version}, rule {rule}: a purchase request of {amount} baht ({basis}) {band}
route.bandBetween: falls in the band above {over} up to {upTo}
route.bandUpTo: falls in the band up to {upTo}
route.escalated: The approver of rule {from} is involved in this request, so it moves up to rule {to}

blocked.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: It cannot be sent yet: nobody holds {position} in {departments} for DOA rule {rule}
blocked.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: It cannot be sent yet: the DOA has no authority above you for this amount (rule {rule})
blocked.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: It cannot be sent yet: your organization has no DOA in effect for purchase requests
blocked.TAX_RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED: It cannot be sent yet: there is no VAT rate for today
blocked.NO_DEPARTMENT: It cannot be sent yet: your account is not in any department
blocked.OTHER: It cannot be sent yet: the DOA finds no approver for this request

route.reported: The administrators have been told. Once it is fixed you can send again

review.title: Title
review.ready: Everything this page can check is complete. You can send it
review.budgetShort: The budget is not enough: {available} baht left, {shortfall} baht short. Lower the amount or choose another budget line
review.saveConflict: This draft was changed elsewhere. Load the latest version and check it again before sending
review.saveClosed: This request was already sent or cancelled elsewhere, so it cannot be sent from this page

saveClosedBy.SENT: This request was already sent elsewhere, so it cannot be sent from this page
saveClosedBy.CANCELLED: This request was already cancelled elsewhere, so it cannot be sent from this page
saveClosedBy.NOT_FOUND: This request is no longer found, so it cannot be sent from this page
saveClosedBy.FORBIDDEN: This account can no longer change this request, so it cannot be sent from this page

problems.TITLE: No request title yet
problems.SERVICE_END_DATE: Item {n} has no service end date
problems.QUOTATION_REASON: The chosen quotation is not the lowest before VAT: give a reason

submit.after: Once sent, the request gets its number, the budget is reserved and the first approver gets the task. You can still cancel it from the request page
submit.afterSupplier: Once sent, the request gets its number and procurement is told
submit.blockedBudget: It cannot be sent because the budget is not enough: {available} baht left, {shortfall} baht short. Lower the amount or choose another budget line
submit.blockedProblems: It cannot be sent until the points marked fix before sending above are fixed
submit.blockedSave: It cannot be sent until you load the latest version of the draft
submit.blockedClosed: It cannot be sent because this request was already sent or cancelled elsewhere

blockedClosedBy.SENT: It cannot be sent because this request was already sent elsewhere
blockedClosedBy.CANCELLED: It cannot be sent because this request was already cancelled elsewhere
blockedClosedBy.NOT_FOUND: It cannot be sent because this request is no longer found
blockedClosedBy.FORBIDDEN: It cannot be sent because this account can no longer change this request

errors.BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT: Not enough budget: {available} baht left, {shortfall} baht short. Lower the amount or choose another budget line, then send again
errors.BUDGET_LINE_CLOSED: This budget line is frozen or closed. Choose another budget line
errors.ATTACHMENT_RULE_FAILED: Documents are missing under rule {rule}: {missing}. Attach them in Quotations and documents, then send again
errors.QUOTE_LOWEST: The chosen quotation is not the lowest before VAT (rule QUOTE-LOWEST). Say why you did not choose the lowest, then send again
errors.QUOTE_SELECTED: Choose the one quotation you will use, then send again
errors.QUOTE_FILE: Quotation {n} has no file. Attach it, then send again
errors.QUOTE_MORE_THAN_ONE: Only one quotation can be chosen
errors.FORM_FIELD: “{field}” is not answered or the answer is not valid
errors.NO_LINES: A request needs at least one complete item
errors.SERVICE_END_DATE: Item {n} needs its service end date
errors.CHOOSE_BUDGET_LINE: Your department has several budget lines. Choose the one this request uses
errors.NO_BUDGET_LINE: No budget line you can use was found. Contact your budget administrator
errors.BUDGET_LINE_YEAR: This budget line belongs to another fiscal year. Choose a line of this year
errors.BUDGET_LINE_NOT_ALLOWED: This budget line belongs to another department and you have no grant to use it. Choose a line of your department
errors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: It cannot be sent because your organization has no DOA in effect for this request. Contact your organization's administrator
errors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: It cannot be sent because nobody holds {position} in {departments}. Contact your organization's administrator
errors.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: It cannot be sent because the DOA has no authority above you for this amount. Contact your organization's administrator
errors.DOA_AMBIGUOUS: It cannot be sent because more than one DOA rule applies. Contact your organization's administrator
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: It cannot be sent because the DOA names you as its approver. Contact your organization's administrator
errors.TAX_RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED: There is no VAT rate for {date}. Contact the platform administrator
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: This draft was changed elsewhere after you opened it. Load the latest version and check it again
errors.STATE: This request was sent or cancelled, so this cannot be done
errors.STATE_SENT: This request was already sent, so this cannot be done. Open the request to see where it stands
errors.STATE_CANCELLED: This request was cancelled, so this cannot be done. Open the request to see its history
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only the requester who owns this request can do this. If you just signed in with another account, sign in with yours and reload this page; if not, ask your organization's administrator to check the account's roles
errors.NOT_FOUND: This request is not found for the account signed in now, so this cannot be done. If you just signed in with another account, sign in with yours and reload this page; if not, contact your organization's administrator
errors.FILE_NOT_FOUND: This file is no longer on the request, so this cannot be done with it. Reload the page to see the files attached now
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then try again
errors.BUSY: Something else is being done to this request. Try again in a moment
errors.FILE: Only files you uploaded and that passed the check can be attached. Upload the file again
errors.KIND: Files of this kind cannot be attached to a request. Choose another kind
errors.ALREADY_ATTACHED: This file is attached to the request already
errors.TOO_MANY: This request has as many files as it can carry. Take off a file you no longer need first
errors.INPUT: Some fields are not valid. Check the fields with a warning and try again
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong in the system. Try again; if it still fails, tell your administrator the reference {requestId}
errors.DRAFT_NOT_SAVED: The latest changes could not be saved, so nothing was sent. See the message at the top of the page and try again
errors.FAILED: That did not work. Try again
errors.fileNotOpened: The file could not be opened, or you may not open it. Try again
errors.adminsTold: The administrators have been told. Once it is fixed you can send it again
errors.adminsNotTold: The administrators could not be told automatically. Please tell them yourself
errors.NO_DEPARTMENT: Your account is not in any department yet. Ask your organization's administrator to set your department first
errors.TOO_LARGE: This draft is too large to save. Remove some items or shorten very long texts, then try again
errors.NO_FORM: This request type no longer has a form in use. Choose another type on the Buy or hire page
errors.LINE_ID: Some items were removed or changed elsewhere. Load the latest version and continue from it
errors.SITE_UNKNOWN: The delivery site you chose is no longer in use. Choose another one in Items
errors.SUPPLIER_UNKNOWN: The suggested supplier is no longer in use. Choose another supplier or none in Quotations and documents
